summary: Committing changes without a reason works again.

fixes.title: Commit without a reason works again
fixes.text: Committing queued changes without a reason failed with an error. The reason is optional again, and the commit goes through.

fixes.title: Run pages show a dash for unknowns
fixes.text: A run page now shows '-' in its number cards when a number is not known, instead of a placeholder word.
